title: Bluebuck and Cape game in the VOC papers received from the Cape (GLOBALISE VOC 3988-4360)

scope.anchor_fts: bokken OR bocken OR hartebeest* OR harte OR eland* OR gemsbok* OR wildt OR gedierte OR gedierten OR quagga* OR zeekoe* OR renoster* OR rhinoceros OR olifant* OR olyphant* OR buffels OR leeuwen OR jagt OR jagen OR geschooten OR landtogt OR landtocht OR wilde

sweep.text_prefilter: blauwe OR blaauwe OR blaauw OR blauw OR blaeuwe

queries.game_list: List of wild game seen or shot on an inland journey at the Cape: elands, hartebeests, bucks, zebras, rhinoceros.
queries.blue_antelope: A large antelope with a bluish-grey coat, shot by the travellers.
queries.hunting_permit: Rules or permits for hunting game, and complaints that game has become scarce near the colony.
queries.specimen: Skins, horns or live animals of the Cape sent to the Netherlands for the Company directors or a menagerie.
queries.nl_game: wij sagen veel wildt als elanden, harte beesten, blaauwe bokken en zebra's

screen.prompt:
You screen machine transcriptions (noisy HTR) of 17th-18th-century Dutch VOC records from the Cape of Good Hope for evidence about WILD LARGE MAMMALS, above all the BLUEBUCK (blaauwbok, blauwe bok/bokken, a bluish-grey antelope). Also flag: quagga; other antelope named or described by colour; lions, elephants, rhinoceros, hippopotamus, buffalo as observed or hunted; lists of game seen on journeys; hunting regulations or scarcity of game; skins, horns or live animals sent to Europe or Batavia.
Do NOT flag: blue cloth or textiles ('blauwe' goods), books ('blaauwboek'), domestic goats or sheep as trade goods, ship names, personal names.
